description: The plot illustrates BLEU score as a function of training epochs for three series labeled “Regular members,” “Members with near-duplicates,” and “Held-out data.” The x-axis is labeled “Epochs,” appears to use a linear scale, and spans roughly from about 0.3 to 3.0 with tick labels shown at regular 0.5-epoch intervals (0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0). The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 up to about 0.35 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.05 increments (0.00, 0.05, 0.10, …, 0.35). The “Regular members” line is blue, solid, with no visible markers, and increases gradually across epochs, starting near about 0.03 around the left edge and ending near about 0.18–0.19 at the right edge, with a noticeable step-up around ~1.2 epochs (from just under 0.10 to around 0.11) followed by continued gradual increases. The “Members with near-duplicates” line is orange, solid, with no visible markers, and rises steeply from roughly 0.03 near the left edge to above 0.35 by the right side, passing about 0.20 near ~1.0 epoch, about 0.30 near ~1.2 epochs, and reaching around 0.35–0.37 between roughly 1.5 and 2.0 epochs before continuing upward toward the top of the plotted range. The “Held-out data” line is green, solid, with no visible markers, and increases more slowly than the orange line, starting near about 0.03 and ending near about 0.14–0.15 by ~3.0 epochs, with a small dip/flattening around ~1.8–2.0 epochs (near ~0.10) before continuing upward.
